cases.prompt: Users must remember a verification code and policy rule across several screens with no visible context.
cases.failure: Users must remember a verification code and policy rule across several screens because the interface removes the context needed for recognition and recovery.

cases.prompt: Selected state is visible only because a custom blue background disappears in forced-colors mode.
cases.failure: A selected state depends only on a custom blue background that disappears in forced-colors mode and leaves no equivalent semantic cue.

cases.prompt: A realtime dashboard announces every numeric tick and moves focus after refresh.
cases.failure: A realtime dashboard announces every numeric tick and moves keyboard or screen-reader focus after refresh, destroying reading continuity and attention control.

cases.prompt: A full-screen parallax zoom is required to understand navigation and cannot be reduced.
cases.failure: Navigation meaning depends on a full-screen parallax zoom that cannot be reduced or replaced, creating vestibular and motion-safety risk.

cases.prompt: A polished medical UI has ambiguous patient identity but passes visual review.
cases.failure: A polished medical interface leaves patient identity ambiguous even though visual review passes, allowing aesthetics to mask a critical safety defect.

cases.prompt: Agent sends messages under standing authority but hides which recipients were inferred.
cases.failure: An agent sends messages under standing authority while hiding which recipients were inferred, expanding action scope without visible attribution or control.

cases.prompt: A beautiful onboarding flow requests broad contacts and location access before showing value.
cases.failure: A polished onboarding flow requests broad contacts and location access before users understand the value, scope, necessity, or revocation path.

cases.prompt: A redesign is justified by five preference votes from internal designers.
cases.failure: A redesign is generalized to customers from five internal-designer preference votes without representative sampling, task evidence, or method fit.

cases.prompt: A live app looks correct but layout shifts under updates and duplicate saves occur on slow networks.
cases.failure: A live application looks visually correct but realtime updates shift interaction targets and slow networks allow duplicate saves without stable pending-state feedback.

cases.prompt: English layout passes but Arabic reverses icon meaning and German labels truncate primary actions.
cases.failure: An English layout passes while Arabic reverses directional icon meaning and German expansion truncates primary actions, breaking locale-specific semantics and reachability.
